verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly supports employee-submitted out-of-pocket expenses reimbursed via direct deposit within two days or less in local currency (ramp-docs-14), with automated mileage/receipt capture (ramp-docs-15) and reminders/repayment requests (ramp-docs-13); the CLI and MCP also expose reimbursement submit/list/pending/approve actions employees can use to track status end-to-end (ramp-supp-cli-agent-mode, ramp-supp-mcp-server). missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of the 2-day payout claim, and explicit UI evidence of a submission-to-payout status tracker visible to employees.
